scripts.migrate: node -e "if (!process.env.DATABASE_URL) { console.error('DATABASE_URL must be set to apply migrations'); process.exit(1); }" && drizzle-kit migrate --config ./drizzle.config.ts
scripts.push:dev: node -e "if (!process.env.DATABASE_URL) { console.error('DATABASE_URL must be set for local schema sync'); process.exit(1); }" && drizzle-kit push --config ./drizzle.config.ts
